name: Use Hanzo AI with Hugging Face
description: Access Hugging Face models and use the HF Inference API through the Hanzo AI API. Also use Hanzo AI models with HuggingFace Hub tooling.

step.name: InferenceClient via Hanzo
step.text:
pip install huggingface_hub

from huggingface_hub import InferenceClient

client = InferenceClient(
    base_url="https://api.hanzo.ai/v1",
    api_key="your-hanzo-api-key",
)

output = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="meta-llama/llama-4-scout",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}],
)

step.name: hf CLI with Hanzo endpoint
step.text:
# Use hf for model downloads, Hanzo for inference
hf download meta-llama/Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E-Instruct

# Then serve via Hanzo API
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI(
    base_url="https://api.hanzo.ai/v1",
    api_key="your-hanzo-api-key",
)
